scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.

The imported polygon covers the Hodgson and Roper region in the Northern Territory from 1600 to 1878. It is treated as approximate map coverage, not a founding date, precise language boundary or extinction. The Darwin suburb and its primary school are not this cultural subject.

Many concrete examples are documented in recent community, language and art sources. They are not projected back to 1600. No undated ancient invention, founding year or archaeological attribution is fabricated.

Edmonds’s Minyerri field account is a situated interpretation of 2003 events. Sensitive ceremonial detail is unnecessary to the card and is not reproduced. Statements about missionary goals are not endorsed as objective descriptions of Aboriginal life.

The 1990 station purchase, 1995 land-trust grant and 1999 corporation establishment are distinct events. The ILC speech calls the station Waliburru; current community and government accounts call it Warrigundu. The card uses Hodgson Downs where needed to avoid implying these are separate acquisitions.
No current speaker, population or employment count is inferred from old reports. No projected 2018 business handover in the 2009 speech is presented as accomplished.

Alawa, Kriol, Marra and Ngalakgan are not interchangeable. Ngukurr is a multilingual community on Ngalakgan land. The two Ellaga artists’ separate relationships are retained; the card does not convert all maternal-country references into exclusive Alawa territory.
Bowdler’s public exhibition interpretation is attributed. No restricted meanings are inferred from shapes. The Araluen award date is dated as an award, not invented as the work’s creation date.

The 1991 ethnobotany book’s catalog was found but its contents were not available. It is not used to invent particular plant uses. The published dictionary announcement supports the separate Ruwu Alawirryunu book description.
Independent historical review, geometry assessment and depth certification remain pending.
